parameters.body:
={
  "model": "claude-sonnet-4-6",
  "max_tokens": 700,
  "messages": [{
    "role": "user",
    "content": "Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Background:
- Bilingual: English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing: SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads, performance marketing
- Data science bootcamp graduate
- Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Projects: dashboards, EDA, machine learning, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

The job:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Role category: {{ $json.role_category }}
Why it fits: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}

Job description (first 1200 chars):
{{ ($json.description||'').substring(0,1200) }}

Make it specific to this job.
Mention how Jerry can:
- Reduce manual analysis time
- Improve reporting speed
- Connect marketing and data
- Build AI-assisted workflows
- Turn messy data into business action

Under 220 words. Confident, direct, human, not desperate.
No "I am writing to express my interest". Start strong."
  }]
}
